discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.5/cis_18.5.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/cis_18.5.x/cis_18.5.10.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Manual: the Ansible role applies this only under conditions we cannot translate into a check, so it is shown as the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.5.10 | PATCH | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds"
  when: win11cis_rule_18_5_10
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_18.5.10
    - screen_saver
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.10
    - NIST800-171_3.1.11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-11_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-12
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2_5
  block:
    - name: "18.5.10 | PATCH | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds | Set Variable"
      when: win11cis_screen_saver_grace_period <= 5
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows Nt\Currentversion\Winlogon
        name: ScreenSaverGracePeriod
        data: "{{ win11cis_screen_saver_grace_period }}"
        type: string

    - name: "18.5.10 | AUDIT | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win11cis_screen_saver_grace_period > 5
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid time set for win11cis_screen_saver_grace_period. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "18.5.10 | AUDIT | Ensure MSS ScreenSaverGracePeriod The time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires is set to Enabled 5 or fewer seconds | Set Warn Count"
      when: win11cis_screen_saver_grace_period > 5
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.5.10'
